verdicts.reason: A: the dark side panel is a sensible width and the logo is a readable size, but alignment is mixed. The headline is centred and leaves 'Evenings' alone on the last line, while the orange divider sits off to the left. 'Ships late June' floats far from its CTA button, and the legal line is too small to read. B: the dark panel takes up about 40% of the width but holds only a tiny logo, so most of that area is empty. All the copy is squeezed into the right side, the orange divider runs into the body text ('kitchen and released'), and the body copy sits off-centre from the headline above it.
